candidate_change: A display library (libpong-display-v245) goes into backboardd only: it reports what the display says of itself and answers the panel's size (1440x3200) where the render server reads the iPhone 16 Pro's (1206x2622: every frame has been enlarged with the nearest neighbour since v242, the jagged edge on text and icons, at 1.5 to 2 ms a frame more). Boot argument pong_ca_native=0 leaves it at watching.  An experiment on the phone: nothing of it has run there.

The signed UI adapter (the same library as in SpringBoard and the other processes of the boot argument) goes into PosterBoard too: its storage adaptation is the only code that can give PosterBoard a data store on the unencrypted Data volume, and without one there is no wallpaper.

The log capture library is v245: in Freeform and kbd a fatal signal is reported with its number, code, address, registers and stack; every line of the render server is passed on for its first ten seconds; the graphics bridge's own lines of Freeform and kbd come to the console (budget of their own); the probe channel's budget is 12000 lines.

The Wi-Fi station has an address of its own, derived from the device tree's unique-chip-id (every boot to v244 came to access points under the radio firmware's default 00:03:7f:12:34:2e); its association request carries Power Capability, Supported Channels, Extended Capabilities and WMM, and sets short slot time and short preamble only where the access point does; when it is refused both frames and the access point's elements are logged.
Every library the injected libraries load is compared with the names Apple's own binaries use.

Carried unchanged from v244: the Wi-Fi daemon's library and the probe, the Settings diagnostic, the console capture, the firmware LUN check with the primary table deciding (v243), the retries and the record of a failed check (v242), the interface-namer marker and the en0 listing in configd (Settings -> About), the panic record slot (v238), protection classes A and B open for every process and IOSurface selector 21 (v237), the v236 GPU timing hook, the v235 witness.  No boot argument changed.
